```artifact
Feature: Alarms in the GUI and Controller

  Scenario: GUI alarm for blocked input air line
    Given the input air line is blocked
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input air line blocked"

  Scenario: GUI alarm for blocked input O2 line
    Given the input O2 line is blocked
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input O2 line blocked"

  Scenario: GUI alarm for inspiratory pressure too low
    Given the inspiratory pressure is below -4 cm H2O
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Inspiratory pressure too low"

  Scenario: GUI alarm for high O2 line pressure
    Given the input O2 line pressure is too high
    When the system detects the high pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input O2 line pressure too high"

  Scenario: Controller alarm for GUI unresponsiveness
    Given the GUI is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    When the system detects the unresponsiveness
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "GUI unresponsive"

  Scenario: Controller alarm for controller unresponsiveness
    Given the controller is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    When the system detects the unresponsiveness
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "Controller unresponsive"

  Scenario: Controller overpressure alarm
    Given the pressure is above 60 cmH2O
    When the system detects the overpressure
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "Overpressure detected"

  Scenario Outline: GUI alarm for blocked input air line with different scenarios
    Given the input air line is <scenario>
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input air line blocked"

    Examples:
      | scenario |
      | blocked  |
      | partially blocked |
      | disconnected |

  Scenario Outline: GUI alarm for blocked input O2 line with different scenarios
    Given the input O2 line is <scenario>
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input O2 line blocked"

    Examples:
      | scenario |
      | blocked  |
      | partially blocked |
      | disconnected |

  Scenario Outline: GUI alarm for inspiratory pressure too low with different scenarios
    Given the inspiratory pressure is <pressure> cm H2O
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Inspiratory pressure too low"

    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | -5       |
      | -3       |
      | -2       |

  Scenario Outline: GUI alarm for high O2 line pressure with different scenarios
    Given the input O2 line pressure is <pressure> cm H2O
    When the system detects the high pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input O2 line pressure too high"

    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | 65       |
      | 70       |
      | 75       |

  Scenario Outline: Controller alarm for GUI unresponsiveness with different scenarios
    Given the GUI is unresponsive for <time> seconds
    When the system detects the unresponsiveness
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "GUI unresponsive"

    Examples:
      | time |
      | 30   |
      | 45   |
      | 60   |

  Scenario Outline: Controller alarm for controller unresponsiveness with different scenarios
    Given the controller is unresponsive for <time> seconds
    When the system detects the unresponsiveness
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "Controller unresponsive"

    Examples:
      | time |
      | 30   |
      | 45   |
      | 60   |

  Scenario Outline: Controller overpressure alarm with different scenarios
    Given the pressure is <pressure> cmH2O
    When the system detects the overpressure
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "Overpressure detected"

    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | 61       |
      | 62       |
      | 63       |
```
